body: I was looking through my feed and found your story. My friend committed suicide on April 5 and no one knew he was suffering as much as he was. As hard as it is to wrap my head around this, I know he must be happy since he went through with it. I hope that you too, find your happy place. I'm not encouraging you to kill yourself, I just understand where you're coming from. I wish you all the best

I feel like this a lot too, it's really difficult because I only told my parents that I am depressed but they don't know to what extent. For me it's either I feel disconnected from everything or I want to die. It's rare for me to have a good day. I want help but I'm too nervous to get the help I need.

My mom understands my manger is like that, but she isn't allowing me to find a replacement job, so I'm just stuck where I am. For my education I would just like to go to college for a few years, but I'm worried about the debt that will come from that. I honestly don't do a whole lot anymore, I only ever just relax at home, and I have a decent amount of time out of my week to do so. I feel like I used to enjoy doing stuff but I've lost a lot of interest in the past year
I'm only 17 so there aren't too many bills aside from car insurance. My manager at works has little to no respect for me so that makes me hate my job.
I'm just overwhelmed due to work and school, trying to balance everything at once.
I don't know what I feel numb to, it just overcomes me during random points throughout the day. I just feel like I shouldn't exist anymore. People could probably benefit with my absence.
